texts.en:
The spirits of the Shroud grow increasingly restless as the time draws near to decide who should lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] during the next term. It is time for each candidate's most potent [GetPsychicNounPlural] to journey to [fed_leader.Capital.GetName], the capital of the current president. There they shall meet to do battle until only the strongest prevails.

To bolster the powers of our own psionic champions, we could tap into our Zro supply. It will give us an additional advantage in the battle.

The spirits of the Shroud grow increasingly restless as the time draws near to decide who should lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] during the next term. We are not an independent state, and therefore are unfortunately barred from participation.

label.zh: 我们可以给出少量泽珞。
label.en: We can sacrifice a small amount.

label.zh: 为我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]选手提供适量泽珞。
label.en: Supply our [GetPsychicNounPlural] with a fair amount.

label.zh: 不给泽珞。我们不借助泽珞也将获得胜利。
label.en: No Zro. We shall win without it.

texts.zh:
随着[GetPsychicNounPlural]们为战斗而聚集，一股显而易见的恐怖气氛弥漫在[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]之上。有报告称闪电风暴突兀而激烈地出现，阴影凭空产生，莫名的声波扰动诡异显现。

战斗开始了。搏斗异常激烈，各支队伍寸步不让。战斗最终变成了耐力测试，一刻的分心就足以导致从虚境中被永久驱除。我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]证明了他们最为训练有素，正如我们所知的那样。胜利属于我们。
texts.en:
As the [GetPsychicNounPlural] gather for the battle, a sense of palpable dread permeates [fed_leader.Capital.GetName]. There are reports of sudden and violent thunderstorms, shadows where none should be, and inexplicable sonic disturbances.

The battle begins. It is an unusually even struggle, with no team willing to yield. In the end it becomes a test of stamina, where a moment of inattention can result in an eternity of banishment in the Shroud. Our [GetPsychicNounPlural] prove the most disciplined, as we know they would. Victory is ours.

随着[GetPsychicNounPlural]们为战斗而聚集，一股显而易见的恐怖气氛弥漫在[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]之上。有报告称闪电风暴突兀而激烈地出现，阴影凭空产生，莫名的声波扰动诡异显现。

战斗开始了。没有一支其他队伍是我们的对手。我们挨个穷追不舍，将他国灵能者的灵能本体喂给了那如饥似渴的虚境。只余下冰冷又不省人事的躯壳。胜利属于我们。
texts.en:
As the [GetPsychicNounPlural] gather for the battle, a sense of palpable dread permeates [fed_leader.Capital.GetName]. There are reports of sudden and violent thunderstorms, shadows where none should be, and inexplicable sonic disturbances.

The battle begins. None of the other teams prove a match for our own. One by one they are hunted down and stripped of their psionic essence which is fed into the ravenous Shroud. Only cold and unresponsive husks remain. Victory is ours.

texts.zh:
在[Root.GetAllianceName]各处的[GetPsychicNounPlural]们应当聚集到[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]的日子到来时，一种意料之外的局面出现了。到头来我们竟是唯一可以召集足够多[GetPsychicNounPlural]参战的成员国。

既然没有人能够战斗，那胜利就属于我们。
texts.en:
As [GetPsychicNounPlural] from across the [Root.GetAllianceName] are meant to be gathering on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName], an unexpected situation arises. As it turns out, we are the only member who could muster enough [GetPsychicNounPlural] to participate.

With no one to fight, the victory goes to us.

label.zh: 虚境今天向我们赐予了祝福。
label.en: The Shroud bestowed fortune upon us today.

texts.zh:
随着[GetPsychicNounPlural]们为战斗而聚集，一股显而易见的恐怖气氛弥漫在[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]之上。有报告称闪电风暴突兀而激烈地出现，阴影凭空产生，莫名的声波扰动诡异显现。

战斗开始了。各支队伍一个接一个摆好架势相互接战，然后又一个接一个地倒下。我们自己的[GetPsychicNounPlural]是最先倒下的那一批，面对对手们的猛攻他们束手无策。

在能量涡旋最终平息后，只剩下[winning_country.GetName]的[GetPsychicNounPlural]还在。
texts.en:
As the [GetPsychicNounPlural] gather for the battle, a sense of palpable dread permeates [fed_leader.Capital.GetName]. There are reports of sudden and violent thunderstorms, shadows where none should be, and inexplicable sonic disturbances.

The battle begins. One by one, the teams square off against each other, and one by one, they fall. Our own [GetPsychicNounPlural] are among the first to go, powerless in the face of their rivals' onslaught.

When the swirling energies finally subside, only the [GetPsychicNounPlural] of the [winning_country.GetName] remain.
